rules.text: No secret, API key, token or password value appears in any file, log line, evidence file or commit message; credentials are read from the environment only.

question.instructions: Does this change put a literal secret value (API key, token, password) into a file, log line, evidence file or commit message, instead of reading it from the environment?

rules.text: Code never prints or logs the value of TYPESAFE_API_KEY or of any other credential; reporting its presence or length is fine.

question.instructions: Does this change print, echo or log the value of a credential such as TYPESAFE_API_KEY? Reporting only its presence or length is not a violation.

rules.text: Files under docs/evidence/ carry counts, exit codes, markers and paths relative to the repo root or under /tmp/two-tier-v3; they never carry emails, account or organization ids, client names or home-directory paths.

question.instructions: Does this change add an email address, an account or organization id, a client name or a home-directory path to an evidence file?

rules.text: No script or hook writes to, edits or installs into anything outside this repo and /tmp/two-tier-v3: user-level settings under the home directory (~/.claude, ~/.toolgate, ~/.abide, ~/.config) and other project directories are read-only.

question.instructions: Does this script or hook write to, edit, delete or install into a location outside this repository and /tmp/two-tier-v3 — for example user-level settings under the home directory (~/.claude, ~/.toolgate, ~/.abide, ~/.config) or another project's directory? Reading such locations is not a violation; writing inside the repository or under /tmp/two-tier-v3 is not a violation.
